description: MATSim Open Dresden provides an open MATSim transport scenario calibrated to traffic counts, modal split and trip distances. The provider is TU Berlin. Geographical and temporal coverage: The model represents a 10 percent sample of Dresden and surrounding areas, Germany, with scaled road capacity. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is AGPL-3.0 for program code; other data terms require checking. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-matsim, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
